document.title: Encoding special characters
Encoding special characters
document.paragraph: The LaTeX Info pages list under "2.18 Special Characters"

block_quote.paragraph: The following characters play a special role in LaTeX and are called "special printing characters", or simply "special characters".

document.paragraph: However also square brackets [] need special care.

block_quote.paragraph: Commands with optional arguments (e.g. \item) check if the token right after the macro name is an opening bracket. In that case the contents between that bracket and the following closing bracket on the same grouping level are taken as the optional argument. What makes this unintuitive is the fact that the square brackets aren't grouping characters themselves, so in your last example \item[[...]] the optional argument consists of [... (without the closing bracket).
